cohort: 86,191 women delivering in a tertiary-level university institution in Dublin, Ireland, from 2007 to 2016
finding: The study found that OVD accounted for almost one in five deliveries and was primarily performed in nulliparous women, suggesting these groups may benefit from interventions to lower OVD rates.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery was more likely in nulliparous women with a singleton, cephalic fetus at term who were induced compared to those who labored spontaneously.
